entries.authority: §12 tail: fixpoint primitives; §8 physical execution keeps WTO and widening as physical policy
entries.proof_obligation: This is the weakest keep in the set: at the pinned ref it imports analysis/engine/internal/composition, analysis/schema and analysis/schema/population, so it is not generic as it stands. The obligation is to separate the fixpoint and WTO core from the composition-coupled part; the core moves to analysis/engine/relation/solve, the remainder deletes with S6-engine-internals. A keep that cannot be split is a delete.

entries.authority: §12 tail: thin typed semantic and column bindings
entries.proof_obligation: Row lowering is the relation store's column discipline if it is generic. At the pinned ref rows imports analysis/schema and analysis/schema/issuance and scalarlower adds ingress, program, program/catalog and structure. The obligation is to show the lowering is addressed by sealed columns rather than by issuance ordinals; if it is, it relocates under the store, otherwise it deletes with S6.
